name: oracle
description: A read-only expert advisor subagent on a stronger reasoning model, for user-requested reviews and unresolved high-impact judgment calls. Model and effort are configurable.

model.title: Oracle model
model.description: The model the oracle runs on: opus (default), best, fable, sonnet, haiku, inherit (the main conversation's), or a full model ID such as claude-opus-5-5[1m].

effort.title: Oracle effort
effort.description: How hard the oracle thinks. auto leaves the model's own default; levels a model lacks fall back to the nearest lower one.

extra_commands.title: Extra read-only commands
extra_commands.description: Comma-separated command prefixes the oracle may also run although Claude Code does not judge them read-only, e.g. "gh pr view, gh pr diff, npm ls". Only add commands that cannot change anything.
